package.name: Agent Link
package.description: Drive FreeCAD from an agent over the Model Context Protocol: 146 tools in 27 groups to make, check, review, simulate, draw and export parts, slice and texture them, in the GUI or headless.

preferencepack.name: Studio Light
preferencepack.description: A flat, quiet light theme: FreeCAD's own stylesheet with one surface per role, hairline borders and a single blue accent. Its colours are theme parameters, editable and exportable.

preferencepack.name: Studio Dark
preferencepack.description: The dark counterpart of Studio Light: the same roles and accent on dark surfaces.
